Vulnerability Name: NFS Shares World Readable / Exported Share Disclosure
Remediation Strategy & Action Taken: Modified /etc/exports to remove wildcard access; restricted mount permissions to specific lab subnet and applied root_squash.
Stopped and disabled 'smbd' and 'nmbd' daemons via update-rc.d to close unpatched legacy NetBIOS/SMB attack vectors.
Stopped the bind9 service and removed it from system boot scripts to eliminate unnecessary DNS attack surface.
Enabled mod_rewrite in Apache2 and configured rewrite rules in apache2.conf to block TRACE/TRACK/PUT/DELETE with 403 Forbidden.

Vulnerability Name: SSL Medium Strength Cipher Suites Supported (SWEET32)
Remediation Strategy & Action Taken: Updated SSL configuration directives in ports.conf and apache2.conf to enforce SSLCipherSuite HIGH and restrict weak legacy algorithms.
Enforced SSLProtocol -ALL +TLSv1 in Apache site configurations to disable insecure legacy SSL protocols.
